title: 49GAION Operating Protocol - signature record
description: The record of one signature of a human position for an action of a listed decision type, made by the position itself or by its own Chief of Staff under a grant the position signed (Protocol §4.10, items 6, 7 and 9; Standard §4.4, items 6 and 8; 49GAION/DR-0053). It holds only the payload hash, Cell codes, times and the sign-in evidence; no person's identity and no reference to one (Standard §1.1, item 9; 49GAION/DR-0049). This schema proves shape only; behaviour (replay, revocation, expiry, wrong executor, altered payload, revoked credential, signer Cell retired or stopped) is tested in the tests of each [ORG]AION's gateway.

signature_id.description: The signature ID recorded in the unit register.

decision_type.description: A type ID of the signature list.

target_code.description: The code of the part the action is on.

payload_hash.description: Hash of the canonical action payload; the gateway runs the call only when its hash equals this.

signer_cell.description: The code of the human Cell the signature is given for: the position whose decision it is, also where its Chief of Staff signed for it.

signer_seat_kind.description: The signer's Cell is a human seat. A signature for an AI Cell, an attached assistant included, is never valid; a position's own Chief of Staff signs for that position, under signer_cell, never for itself (Protocol §4.10, items 6 and 7).

signer_role.$comment: RULE-NO-ACTING-OR-DEPUTY: acting fillers and deputies are the organisation's own mechanism (49GAION/DR-0049)
signer_role.description: Withdrawn by 49GAION/DR-0049. The signer is the position, under its own Cell code; whether a position has an acting holder or a deputy is the organisation's own mechanism, outside the system. A record that carries this field is refused.

delegation_ref.$comment: RULE-NO-ACTING-OR-DEPUTY: acting fillers and deputies are the organisation's own mechanism (49GAION/DR-0049)
delegation_ref.description: Withdrawn by 49GAION/DR-0049, with signer_role. Delegation between positions is read from the signing Cell's authority_scope (Standard §4.4, item 8). A record that carries this field is refused.

signer_identity_ref.$comment: RULE-NO-PERSON-REFERENCE: no person's identity, and no reference to one, in the system (49GAION/DR-0049)
signer_identity_ref.description: Withdrawn by 49GAION/DR-0049. The system records no person's identity and no reference to one; any record of who stood behind a signature is the organisation's own, outside the system (Standard §1.1, item 9). A record that carries this field is refused.

signer_credential.description: The credential the organisation's mechanism issued for the signing position, used with a fresh live sign-in (Standard §1.1, item 9; HF-10); or, for a signature by the position's own Chief of Staff, its credential under a grant the position signed with such a sign-in (Protocol §4.10, items 6 and 10). Never another AI credential or a technical key.

kind.description: human-live-sign-in: the position signed itself. chief-of-staff-under-grant: its own Chief of Staff signed under its grant (under_grant). Never another AI credential or a technical key.

authenticator.description: The sign-in the position made: at signing, or, for a signature under a grant, when it signed the grant.

bound_to_one_person.$comment: RULE-NO-PERSON-REFERENCE: the gateway verifies the credential for the position, never the person (49GAION/DR-0049)
bound_to_one_person.description: Withdrawn by 49GAION/DR-0049: how the organisation issues its credentials is its own mechanism, outside the system. A record that carries this field is refused.

under_grant.description: For a signature by the position's own Chief of Staff: the grant it signed under, which the position signed with a fresh live sign-in and the gateway recorded, and the Chief of Staff's Cell. The gateway runs the action only while that grant is in force and reaches its type, and never with the Chief of Staff as the executor (Protocol §4.10, items 6, 9 and 11).

grant_ref.description: The event ID of the grant in the record at the gateway (Protocol §24, item 9).

chief_of_staff_cell.description: The code of the position's own Chief of Staff Cell, which signed.

executor_cell.description: The Cell that may run the signed action; the gateway checks the caller is this Cell.

nonce.description: Single-use; the gateway refuses a nonce already used.

session_ref.description: The reference of the sign-in event at the organisation's mechanism, as evidence of the fresh live sign-in; it carries no person's identity.

sign_in_evidence.description: Evidence of the fresh live sign-in (HF-10): made at signing, or, for a signature under a grant, made when the position signed the grant.

allOf.$comment: RULE-COS-UNDER-GRANT: a Chief of Staff signs only under its position's grant, and a position's own signature names no grant (49GAION/DR-0053)
